reference: Hand-designed corpus written from SPEC-h2-co2-pipeline-repurposing.md rev 2026-10-17.6 (model 2026-10-11.hc-4, unchanged in rev .5; including the section 13.11 corrections) alone; 346 cases: 254 from rev .3 re-derived, 70 for the impure-CO2 screen of SPEC 13 (rev .4) and 22 for the hydrogen bubble-side band of SPEC 13.6-13.7 (rev .5, group h2-band). Expected values from an independent implementation: ref_impl.py (standard library; Span-Wagner derivative derived by hand, root search as in SPEC section 4) and ref_mixture.py (SPEC 13: residual Helmholtz energy of teqp 0.23.2 'multifluid' with the fluiddata/dev files named in SPEC 13.2, chemical potentials with the composition derivative of R removed as SPEC 13.3 states; density scan, saturation Newton system, Wilson start, continuation, central-difference extremum search, crossing bisections, monotone-branch density scans, stable single-phase root and bubble-side band b_bub written from SPEC 13.3-13.7 and 13.11). Second route (verify.py, verify_mixture.py): mpmath Span-Wagner with numerical delta-derivative and CoolProp root bracketing for pure CO2; for mixtures CoolProp 8.0.0 HEOS (NORMALIZE_GAS_CONSTANTS false) densities, dew/bubble/cricondentherm/cricondenbar roots re-solved with MINPACK from perturbed starts, reducing density from teqp's own reducing functions, phase labels checked by a Michelsen tangent-plane stability test, and the selection / check / gap / action logic re-implemented separately. The envelope topology (which crossings exist, crit step, open/closed trace) of the second route is taken from the reference trace, so it is checked only through the stability test.

tolerance: Numbers: |a - e| <= 1e-9 * |e| (purely relative; an expected 0 requires exactly 0). In a case screened by SPEC 13 (expected phase with model 'multifluid'): |a - e| <= 1e-6 * |e| for the numbers inside phase and for the value of the checks phase and phase_margin (SPEC 10 and 13.9). Why 1e-6 there: the mixture numbers are roots of a Newton system with a central-difference Jacobian and bisections on an envelope trace, and SPEC 13.9 states 1e-6 as the reproducibility of an independent implementation; the reference and the CoolProp route agree to 1.3e-12 (dew/bubble) and 1e-14 (density), so 1e-6 is the SPEC's contract, not a measured scatter. Every SPEC 13 case keeps its decisions clear of that tolerance: corner and window temperatures > 0.5 K from a crit step and from T_cdt, P > 1e-6 relative from c1/c2, from the band edges 0.03 c1 and b_bub c2 and, in co2dense with H2, (P - p_ref)/p_ref > 1e-6 from b_bub (band cases at 1e-4 relative), rho > 1e-6 relative from rho_r and from dense_min_density. Objects are compared over the keys given in expected; arrays element by element with equal length; strings, booleans and null exactly. notes: SPEC 13 cross-check, corpus mixture states (verify.py, rev .5 corpus of 72 SPEC 13 cases): CoolProp 8.0.0 HEOS with NORMALIZE_GAS_CONSTANTS false - 55 densities, max relative difference 1.0e-14 (median 8.9e-16); 102 dew pressures max 1.3e-12 (median 7.1e-15); 112 bubble pressures max 2.7e-13 (median 2.2e-14); 69 cricondentherms (T of the CoolProp saturation curve at p_cdt) max 2.3e-12, maximum confirmed on both sides; tangent-plane stability agrees with the phase label in 63 of 63 single/two-phase states; reducing density from teqp's reducing functions agrees to better than 1e-12 for every binary pair.

Direct flash, for information: CoolProp QT flash at the corpus temperatures - dew pressures (56) max 1.5e-12; bubble pressures (49) median 3.6e-13 but max 0.76 (CoolProp's mixture QT flash converges to another root at some H2-bearing and low-temperature states; the traced envelope and the MINPACK route agree with the reference).

teqp 0.23.2 multifluid with teqp's own fugacity coefficients (composition derivative of R = sum x_i R_i included, unlike SPEC 13.3): dew pressures (61) max 1.0e-6 (median 3.5e-8), bubble pressures (57) max 2.8e-5 (median 2.9e-7); the differences come from streams with O2, H2 or CO, whose R_i differ from 8.31451 (SPEC 13.9 states up to 1.7e-5).

Model difference (information): teqp GERG2008resid (GERG-2008 pure equations and binary set) at the corpus states - densities (54) median 1.6e-4, max 1.2e-2; dew pressures (61) median 1.5e-4, max 9.8e-3; bubble pressures (57) median 6.2e-4, max 0.15 (mix-random-7; 8.2e-2 for 3 % O2 at 278.15 K): GERG-2008 and EOS-CG differ mainly in the CO2-O2, CO2-Ar and CO2-CO pairs.

Pressure extrema (SPEC 13.5.3 with the 13.11.2 central-difference g): inserted pressure maxima (cricondenbar, 5) lie within 1.1e-13 and minima (3) within 1.4e-12 of the true extremum found by a bounded search on CoolProp roots (before the correction: 7.6e-10 and 7.1e-6 / 0.19 K). Minima are not an output (never the window maximum), so no case could be added for them.

Stable single-phase root (13.11.4): 7 liquid_like/supercritical corpus corners have only the liquid root, 17 have coinciding liquid and vapour roots (tie rule); no single-phase state with two distinct roots was found, so the Gibbs comparison itself is not benchmarked (AMBIGUITIES #87). Both routes reproduce the SPEC's example: 4 % N2, 278.15 K: no liquid root at 3 MPa, stable root 896.1039 kg/m3 at 10 MPa.

Random states: 3000 pure/hydrogen/evidence states and 60 impure-CO2 states (seed 4112026, mixture screens: liquid_like 18, supercritical 8, two_phase 3, gas_like 2, solid_region 1; others blocked or evidence route; since rev .5 the H2-bearing ones carry phase_assessment confirmed and phase_margin_min 0.1, 1 of them with h2_margin_band) give 0 disagreements between ref_impl.py and verify.py; the 8 corpus cases mix-random-1..8 are drawn with seed 20261011 (make_cases.py, g_mix_random) and stored in full in their inputs.
